_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround on a {width}x{height} grid.
E yin player {player_id}. Nuhe he nọ pọnde: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' kavi w/s/a/d.
Nuyọnẹ: mọ to whenue kẹkẹ atọ̀n. Trails wẹ doyi; owọ́ gbẹtọ lẹ ku; head-on crashes wá ku ye dukọ.

board.after_moves: Akɔkpá ɔ́ ɖò tɛn ɖokpó jí: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Player {player_id} died due to invalid move.

outcome.all_crashed: Kántɔ́ lɛ bǐ jɛ nǔ dó jí ɖò hwe ɖokpo ɔ mɛ.
outcome.outlived: Kántóo ɔ nɔ gbɛ hú mɛ ɖevo lɛ bǐ.
outcome.all_dead: Mɛ e ɖò ɔ́ bǐ kú.
outcome.turn_limit: Nú è ko mɔ tɛn bo na lɛ́ kɔ dó ɔ, mɛ e ná nɔ te káká bɔ é na kú é wɛ ɖu ɖ'é jí.
